description.en: Translate HWP/HWPX (Hangul) documents into Chinese with the original layout preserved; the agent calls a 14 MB local tool instead of loading a full office suite.
description.zh: 把 HWP/HWPX（한글）文档翻成中文并保留原格式；agent 调用的是 14 MB 的本地专用工具，不加载整套办公组件。

description.en: Translates .hwp/.hwpx (Hangul) and .docx into any language the session model writes (Chinese is the common case), keeping tables, bullets, indentation and font size, and writes *_zh beside the original. Two offline tools: hwp_extract returns segments as JSON (50 per page by default, 200 max, next_offset for pagination); hwp_apply takes {segment id: translation} and returns the output path with applied/missing. Translation must come from the calling session model: the plugin never calls an API and accepts no API key. Windows only: .hwpx/.docx are pure Python, legacy .hwp drives the installed Hangul over COM and requires allow_hangul.
description.zh: 把 .hwp/.hwpx（한글）与 .docx 翻成会话模型能写的任意语言（中文是最常见的目标），保留表格、项目符号、缩进与字号，译文写在原文件旁（原名_zh）。两个离线工具：hwp_extract 返回段落 JSON（默认每页 50 段、上限 200，next_offset 分页）；hwp_apply 按 {段落 id: 译文} 写回，返回输出路径与 applied/missing。译文必须由调用方会话模型提供：插件不访问任何 API、也不接受 API Key。仅 Windows：.hwpx/.docx 纯 Python，旧版 .hwp 通过 COM 驱动本机 한글，需要 allow_hangul。
